snapshot.reason: The company announced a privatization proposal by W.F Group Limited via a scheme of arrangement, which typically results in the stock price converging toward the offer price.
snapshot.why_now: The announcement was made on 2026-09-29 and trading resumed on 2026-09-30.
source_headlines: MAOYE INT'L (00848): JOINT ANNOUNCEMENT (1) PROPOSAL FOR THE PRIVATISATION OF MAOYE INTERNATIONAL HOLDINGS LIMITED BY W.F GROUP LIMITED BY WAY OF A SCHEME OF ARRANGEMENT UNDER SECTION 86 OF THE COMPANIES ACT OF THE CAYMAN ISLANDS; (2) PROPOSED WITHDRAWAL OF LISTING (3) SPECIAL DEAL RELATING TO THE ROLLOVER ARRANGEMENT; AND (4) RESUMPTION OF TRADING
